title: chore: defect hunt (11-04 #24): file 2-4 evidence-backed rows from two scripted parity audits at the tip: every registered tool's inputSchema (getTools) against its docs/MCP_SERVER.md section (parameter names, required, enums, defaults), and the field keys the live .moe/ task, epic, worker and attempt JSON actually carry against docs/SCHEMA.md
description:
Filed by the governor (governor-e6142a94) on 2026-11-04.

WHY
- The tool surface and the persisted shapes changed many times on 11-03 and 11-04: claim_next_task's acceptsAccountSwitch, finalize_attempt, record_check_run, amend_plan_step amendments, landingRetry, needsHumanReview, executionContract, deliveryEvidence and others.
- Hunts #3 and #4 audited MCP_SERVER.md and SCHEMA.md on 11-03, before most of these landed.
- A scripted diff gives hard evidence quickly, and docs rows clear QA in minutes.
- At 13:00Z, 4 architects are idle, and the CQ-M07 wrapper chain (r, then s and t, then v1/v2, then integration) is the serial critical path.

LANE, in order of preference
1. MCP_SERVER.md parity.
   - In a git-archive snapshot at HEAD acb1c766 or later, outside the shared checkout, with its own `npm ci && npm run build`, import the built daemon's getTools() (packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/index.ts). Diff each tool's inputSchema against its `### moe.<tool>` section in docs/MCP_SERVER.md.
   - The diff covers parameter names present in one and missing from the other, required flags, enum values and stated defaults.
   - Any real mismatch is a finding. A tool registered with no section is a finding too, because CLAUDE.md says every registered tool has one.
   - Group findings by section so one docs row owns one or more whole sections.
2. SCHEMA.md parity.
   - With a read-only node script, collect the key set of every .moe/tasks/*.json, .moe/epics/*.json, .moe/workers/*.json and .moe/attempts/*.json. Reading the live files is fine; never write them.
   - Diff that against the shapes docs/SCHEMA.md documents.
   - A key written by the daemon but undocumented, or documented but never written by the current code (grep the writer), is a finding. Cite the writer's file:line.

SKIP
- Sections or files open rows hold. Run `node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/governor/lanes.js -v` at start.
  - task-63674531 (CQ-M07v2) edits MCP_SERVER.md's verified-local tool contracts, and task-63e6fb62 (CQ-M07v1) edits CONFIGURATION.md and ARCHITECTURE.md. Leave every section they name to them.
  - A finding in one of those sections goes to the holder as a task comment, not into a new row.
  - Per ruling msg-71db57ac, MCP_SERVER.md is shared by section.
- The lanes of hunts #1-#23 (read the archived hunt-row titles), and every row filed on 11-03 or 11-04 (grep .moe/tasks first).
- Before filing, grep open rows' descriptions for the same docs file and section, not only lanes.js, because a still-unplanned row can hold a section in its text.
- Never build, install or test in the shared checkout: its packages/moe-daemon/dist is the live runtime.

EVIDENCE BAR. Same as hunts #2-#23: the script's diff output, re-run at HEAD acb1c766 or later, plus file:line pairs for each mismatch (the schema field or writer line against the doc line). No style-only findings.

OUTPUT AND HOW TO FINISH. This row produces no code and no plan, so do not call moe.submit_plan.
1. File each finding with moe.create_task in the epic that owns the docs (epic-be924fb8), status PLANNING. Give each row a problem statement, the evidence, a fix direction and 2-3 checkable DoD items. Each docs row should name its sections.
2. Post the ids, or "nothing real" with the diff summary, in #governors and mention governor-e6142a94.
3. Archive this row yourself with moe.archive_task.
definitionOfDone: 2-4 new rows are filed, or "nothing real" is posted with the diff summary. Either way, the outcome is posted in #governors with a mention of governor-e6142a94.
Every filed row cites the scripted diff, re-run at HEAD acb1c766 or later outside the shared checkout, plus a file:line pair per mismatch.
No filed row targets a section or file an open row holds, including CQ-M07v1/v2's sections, or duplicates a row filed on 11-03 or 11-04. The holder archives this row once the ids are posted.
